summary: Frontend-focused testing of new Réserves BIM & Export 4D PDF features on DEMO-DUPLEX. All flows verified: (1) IssuesPage KPIs + table + create dialog, (2) full workflow transitions ouvert→affecte→en_cours→(422 bare)→a_verifier(+note+photo)→resolu→cloture with photo upload (preuve) displayed as thumbnail, comment added, history grows, (3) BIM-linked issue creation from Models page (prop-create-issue-btn → banner shows IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE · Basic Wall:Interior · Level 1 → RES-0003 created and shown under Réserves(2) in PropertiesPanel), (4) lecteur has no issue-new-btn and no prop-create-issue-btn, API POST /issues returns 403, (5) 4D PDF report generated via report-open-btn → 4 captures → PDF 131,901 bytes / 5 pages (cover + 4) saved to /app/test_reports/report4d.pdf, progress indicator visible with 'Capture 2/4 — 16 oct. 2026'. Found and fixed one CRITICAL runtime bug on Bim4DPage.jsx (TDZ: countsAt declared before visibleIds).

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error 'Cannot access visibleIds before initialization' blocked the entire 4D page (viewer-stats never rendered, Rapport PDF button inaccessible). Root cause: const countsAt = useCallback(...) on line 81 referenced visibleIds which was declared on line 83 (TDZ). FIXED by moving visibleIds useMemo above countsAt useCallback.

issues: Radix warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Add VisuallyHidden DialogDescription or aria-describedby to IssueCreateDialog, ReportDialog etc.
Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' persists.

action_items: (DONE by testing agent) Fixed TDZ in /app/frontend/src/pages/Bim4DPage.jsx by reordering visibleIds before countsAt — please review the hoisting is semantically equivalent (it is: both are stable memos driven by same inputs).
(Low) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to IssueCreateDialog, ReportDialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.

(Low) In Models page, when creating an issue from prop-create-issue-btn the IssueSheet does not auto-open (unlike IssuesPage). Consider wiring onCreated → setOpenId or a toast with a 'Voir la réserve' link for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Bim4DPage.jsx was broken on this iteration due to variable-before-declaration — this file is large (143 lines) and the hooks ordering must be strict. Consider adding ESLint 'no-use-before-define' and 'react-hooks/exhaustive-deps' CI gates.

ReportDialog uses canvas.toDataURL at 0.72 quality for JPEG captures — fine for A4, but the WebGL context MUST have preserveDrawingBuffer=true at IFCViewer creation (confirmed in viewer code). If a future refactor loses that flag, PDFs will contain black images.

IssueSheet uses blob URL `createObjectURL` but revokes it in the useEffect cleanup only if `u` was captured; for photos replaced within the same component instance this is OK, but if many photos are added quickly the first blob URL is replaced in state without immediate revocation — potential small memory leak, acceptable for v1.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after TDZ fix (all requested flows green)
